package relationdeleteconsumer

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"reflect"

	"github.com/progresshans/godj/conformance/relationdeleteproduct/authors"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/conformance/relationdeleteproduct/blog"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/conformance/relationdeleteproduct/project"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/db"
	"github.com/progresshans/godj/orm"
)

var generatedRelationDeletePrerequisites = [...]string{
	authors.GoDjGeneratorVersion,
	authors.GoDjRelationMetadataGeneratorVersion,
	authors.GoDjRelationObjectGeneratorVersion,
	authors.GoDjRelationProjectionGeneratorVersion,
	blog.GoDjGeneratorVersion,
	blog.GoDjRelationMetadataGeneratorVersion,
	blog.GoDjRelationQueryGeneratorVersion,
	blog.GoDjRelationObjectGeneratorVersion,
	blog.GoDjRelationProjectionGeneratorVersion,
	project.GoDjProjectBindingGeneratorVersion,
	project.GoDjProjectRelationObjectGeneratorVersion,
	project.GoDjProjectRelationSelectRelatedGeneratorVersion,
	project.GoDjProjectRelationDeleteGeneratorVersion,
}

var (
	_ orm.WriteDescriptor[authors.Author]                                                                           = authors.AuthorDescriptor{}
	_ orm.RelationDeleter[authors.Author]                                                                           = project.RelationDeleters{}.AuthorsAuthor
	_ func() (project.RelationDeleters, error)                                                                      = project.BindRelationDeleters
	_ func(orm.RelationDeleter[authors.Author], context.Context, db.RelationAtomic, *authors.Author) (int64, error) = orm.RelationDeleter[authors.Author].Delete
)

var boundRelationDeleters project.RelationDeleters

func init() {
	if len(generatedRelationDeletePrerequisites) != 13 {
		panic("generated relation-delete prerequisite inventory is not exact 13")
	}
	aggregateType := reflect.TypeOf((*project.RelationDeleters)(nil)).Elem()
	deleterType := reflect.TypeOf((*orm.RelationDeleter[authors.Author])(nil)).Elem()
	if aggregateType.NumField() != 1 ||
		aggregateType.Field(0).Name != "AuthorsAuthor" ||
		aggregateType.Field(0).Type != deleterType {
		panic(fmt.Sprintf("generated RelationDeleters surface = %v, want one AuthorsAuthor %v field", aggregateType, deleterType))
	}
	var err error
	boundRelationDeleters, err = project.BindRelationDeleters()
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}

func deleteAuthor(
	ctx context.Context,
	backend db.RelationAtomic,
	author *authors.Author,
) (int64, error) {
	return boundRelationDeleters.AuthorsAuthor.Delete(ctx, backend, author)
}
